# Journalism Extras v1.0.10

> Useful TypeScript functions for journalism projects. This library holds any functions and classes that do not fit in the other journalism modules.

- [README](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/nshiab/journalism-extras/v1.0.10/README.md): Installation, examples and usage.

## API
- [DurationTracker](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/nshiab/journalism-extras/v1.0.10/docs/classes/DurationTracker.md): DurationTracker class
- [createDirectory](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/nshiab/journalism-extras/v1.0.10/docs/functions/createDirectory.md): createDirectory function
- [getId](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/nshiab/journalism-extras/v1.0.10/docs/functions/getId.md): getId function
- [reencode](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/nshiab/journalism-extras/v1.0.10/docs/functions/reencode.md): reencode function
- [removeDirectory](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/nshiab/journalism-extras/v1.0.10/docs/functions/removeDirectory.md): removeDirectory function
- [sleep](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/nshiab/journalism-extras/v1.0.10/docs/functions/sleep.md): sleep function
- [unzip](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/nshiab/journalism-extras/v1.0.10/docs/functions/unzip.md): unzip function
- [zip](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/nshiab/journalism-extras/v1.0.10/docs/functions/zip.md): zip function
